challengeTypes: identify: What is the difference between WEATHER and CLIMATE? (Weather is day-to-day condition, climate is average over years vs They are the same | Weather is over years, climate is daily | Both mean the same thing)

sort: Drag each weather element to its correct description (Temperature = how hot or cold | Humidity = moisture in air | Rainfall = amount of rain | Wind = speed and direction of air | Sunny = clear sky and sunlight | Cloudy = sky covered with clouds)
identify: Why are plants important for the environment? (They give oxygen, food, and shelter vs They cause pollution | They use up all water | They are not important)

sort: Drag each plant or animal to land or water (Mango tree = Land | Lotus = Water | Cow = Land | Fish = Water | Seaweed = Water | Grass = Land | Frog = Both land and water | Duck = Both land and water)
identify: Which of these is a HEALTHY food combination? (Rice with dal and vegetables vs Only burger and fries | Only chocolate | Only soda and chips)

sort: Drag each food to its correct food group (Rice and wheat = Carbohydrates (energy) | Dal and pulses = Proteins (body building) | Fruits and vegetables = Vitamins and minerals | Milk and cheese = Calcium and proteins | Butter and oil = Fats (limited use) | Green leafy vegetables = Iron)
identify: Which building in the locality provides EDUCATION? (School vs Health centre | Post office | Police station)

sort: Drag each building to its correct function (School = education for children | Health centre = medical treatment | Post office = sending letters and parcels | Police station = safety and law enforcement | Bank = saving and borrowing money | Market = buying food and goods | Library = reading and borrowing books | Temple/Mosque/Church = worship)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Weather and climate — Weather: day-to-day condition of the atmosphere (today is sunny, tomorrow may be rainy). Elements: temperature (hot/cold), humidity (moisture in air), rainfall, wind (speed and direction). Climate: average weather of a place over many years (Mumbai has a coastal climate, Delhi has an extreme climate). Weather affects daily life: what we wear, what we eat, whether we carry an umbrella. (2) Importance of plants and animals — Plants: give oxygen (photosynthesis), food (fruits, vegetables, grains), shelter (wood), medicine, prevent soil erosion, provide shade. Animals: give food (milk, eggs, meat), help in farming (bullocks), provide wool and silk, maintain ecosystem balance. Land plants: trees, grass, crops. Water plants: lotus, seaweed, water hyacinth. Land animals: cow, dog, tiger, elephant. Water animals: fish, whale, dolphin. Some live in both: frog, duck, crocodile. (3) Dependence on environment for food — We depend on the environment for all our food. Healthy food combinations: rice/wheat (carbohydrates for energy) + dal/pulses (proteins for body building) + fruits and vegetables (vitamins and minerals for immunity) + milk (calcium for bones). A balanced diet has all food groups in right proportions. Avoid junk food. (4) Buildings in the locality — School: education for children. Health centre/hospital: medical treatment and health care. Post office: sending letters, parcels, and money orders. Police station: safety and law enforcement. Bank: saving and borrowing money. Market/shops: buying food and goods. Library: reading and borrowing books. Temple/mosque/church: place of worship. These buildings serve the community and make life easier. Misconceptions: 'weather and climate are the same' (WRONG — weather is day-to-day condition; climate is the average weather over many years), 'plants are only useful for food' (WRONG — plants give oxygen, shelter, medicine, prevent soil erosion, and maintain the ecosystem), 'animals that live in water cannot come on land' (WRONG — some animals like frogs, ducks, and crocodiles live in both water and on land), 'only expensive food is healthy' (WRONG — simple foods like rice, dal, vegetables, and fruits are very healthy; expensive junk food is unhealthy), 'a post office is only for letters' (WRONG — post offices also handle parcels, money orders, savings accounts, and bill payments).
